# Data Source UNIX user

Retrieves the specified UNIX user in the SVM

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver services name-service unix-user show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.9 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_unix_user" "unix_user" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  name = "root"
  svm_name = "svm1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `name` (String) The name of the UNIX user.
- `svm_name` (String) The name of the SVM.

### Read-Only

- `full_name` (String) Full name of the UNIX user.
- `id` (Number) UNIX user ID of the specified user.
- `primary_gid` (Number) Primary group ID to which the UNIX user belongs.
